variances.title: WAGR-271 (Done) lets Reps reactivate archived Sign-Ups, but the client decided that only Ops can unarchive

jira.quote:
Let Reps pull an archived Sign-Up back into the working queue.

Implementation Requirements

* Reactivate button on the Sign-Up Lightning record page, visible ONLY when Status = Archived

transcript_evidence.quote: Lina Ceniccola: I just want to make sure that once they archive it they can't unarchchive / Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah, like we can restrict that. So only like ops can unarchive something. / Kobi Kunasekaran: you can still go in and you can move the status to in progress

later_or_conflicting_evidence.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: And then for archive records we added the reactivate button. So, um, if I click on reactivate, um, it'll bring it back to in progress. ... Um, and for archive and fraud, we have the, uh, the new reasons that you provided in the open questions lock. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Um, and if they choose other, they'll need to provide the additional information.

variances.what_differs: On Jul 22 Lina asked that reps not be able to unarchive and Kobi agreed that only Ops can move an archived sign-up back to In Progress. WAGR-271 states the objective as letting Reps reactivate and limits visibility only by Status = Archived, with no persona restriction; no other ticket (WAGR-37, WAGR-494, WAGR-495, WAGR-496) records the Ops-only rule.
variances.suggested_action: Suggestion only: confirm in PartialSB whether a Rep user can see the Reactivate button. If yes, restrict it to Ops (page visibility or permission) and record the Ops-only rule in the persona access matrix (WAGR-495/WAGR-496).
variances.reasoning: L1224 is tier1 and decided (client ask, Jumpr agreed). The later Jul 28 demo (L1345) shows the button but does not say who can use it; no later ledger item reverses the rule. Confidence is medium because the built button may already be hidden from Reps by page filters. Same finding as area variance ACCESS-01; listed here for Jira-side completeness so the merge step can dedupe it.
